question: Give me the three most important airports (smallest scalerank) in each airport type, with their IATA code and coordinates.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT type, name, iata_code, scalerank, ST_X(geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(geometry) AS latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY scalerank ASC, name ASC) AS rn FROM airports) SELECT type, name, iata_code, scalerank, longitude, latitude FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY type, rn;

question: List the top 2 most populous populated places in each country, with their coordinates.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT country, name, pop_max, ST_X(geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(geometry) AS latitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY pop_max DESC, name ASC) AS rn FROM populated_places) SELECT country, name, pop_max, longitude, latitude FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY country, rn;

question: For each feature class, map the single most populous place as GeoJSON.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT feature_class, name, country, pop_max, geometry, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY feature_class ORDER BY pop_max DESC, name ASC) AS rn FROM populated_places) SELECT feature_class, name, country, pop_max, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY feature_class;

question: Give me the two westernmost airports in each type, ranked by longitude.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT type, name, iata_code, ST_X(geometry) AS longitude, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY ST_X(geometry) ASC, name ASC) AS rn FROM airports) SELECT type, name, iata_code, longitude FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY type, rn;

question: List the top 10 populated places in the United States by population, with a running total of their populations.
sql: WITH top10 AS (SELECT name, pop_max, geometry FROM populated_places WHERE country = 'United States of America' ORDER BY pop_max DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT name, pop_max, SUM(pop_max) OVER (ORDER BY pop_max DESC, name ASC) AS running_total, ST_X(geometry) AS longitude, ST_Y(geometry) AS latitude FROM top10 ORDER BY pop_max DESC, name ASC;

question: For each airport type, give the airport closest to the equator (smallest absolute latitude).
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT type, name, iata_code, ST_Y(geometry) AS latitude, ABS(ST_Y(geometry)) AS abs_latitude, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY ABS(ST_Y(geometry)) ASC, name ASC) AS rnk FROM airports) SELECT type, name, iata_code, latitude FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY type;
